{{Quote|Grease bucket, forgive me. You're my favorite ship ever.|Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="TCW junior novel">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' junior novelization]]</ref>}}
The '''''Twilight''''' was a [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter/Legends|G9 Rigger freighter]] that was originally used by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] as a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Later in the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], used it to take Hutt crime lord [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Rotta/Legends|son]] back to his home [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], but were [[Mission to Jabba's Palace (Clone Wars)/Legends|shot down]] over the planet and were forced to crash-land the ship. After they abandoned it, the ship was scavenged by [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], and Skywalker later returned and reclaimed it.

After it had been reclaimed, the ''Twilight'' was later used by Skywalker in several missions during the coming events in the war. These included Skywalker and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] rescue of [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] aboard the Confederacy warship [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] during the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]], as well as Skywalker and Tano's [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|mission]] to destroy a Confederacy [[Skytop Station/Legends|listening post]]. Additionally, Skywalker and Kenobi took the freighter to [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] to confirm that [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and Confederacy [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] had been captured by [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirates]], in order for a deal to be struck between the pirates and the Galactic Republic, and the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] later used the ''Twilight'' to [[Mission to Iego/Legends|find]] an [[Reeksa/Legends|antidote]] for the deadly [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]] on the planet [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]. Later on, the ''Twilight'' would be used once again by Skywalker and Tano during their [[Mission to Mustafar (Skywalker and Tano)/Legends|mission]] to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], it was discovered that Darth Maul had taken over the planet Mandalore with the help of Pre Vizsla and the Death Watch. Kenobi used the freighter as a way of sneaking in to rescue Duchess Satine Kryze, who had been imprisoned by Maul. The two attempted to escape in the ''Twilight'' but it was hit by a missile and crashed, forcing them out of the ship.

==Description==
{{Quote|Get aboard and prime the engines...assuming it ''has'' engines.|Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="TCW film" />}}
[[File:Twilight_console.png|thumb|left|200px|The ''Twilight''{{'s}} console display.]]

The ''Twilight'' had one big main wing and one retractable second wing, which was placed under the main wing and was approximately half the size of the main wing. The retractable wing was called a [[Tal Nami Freighter Swing Wing]], which gave the craft extra maneuverability. It was also equipped with one heavy [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] cannon. Another smaller retractable wing was placed above the main wing equipped with a double heavy [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] cannon. If needed the wing would go in the upright position to allow the blasters to be fired. The cockpit was positioned between the main wing and the main engine. [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] traveled inside this cockpit with the ship's captain, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Just next to the cockpit, the main wing housed two small, secondary engines. Despite similarities to the later [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]], it was of [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian manufacture]].<ref name="Visual Guide" />

The ship was armed with three heavy [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], located on struts around the ship, [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] and also had a rotating [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] mounted on the main wing, with periscope controls. The ''Twilight'' had a small [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] in its rear, big enough to fit Skywalker's [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighter]].<ref name="Downfall of a Droid">{{TCW|Downfall of a Droid}}</ref> The hangar was otherwise used as a cargo hold and was equipped with a magnetic field to allow outer space transfer of goods. A tow cable was placed to winch in heavy containers. The ship also had a boarding ramp underneath the vessel, which acted as the main entrance to the ship. The hangar door could also be used as an exit and entrance to the ship.<ref name="TCW film" />

==History==
===Spice freighter===
Not designed as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], the ''Twilight'' had been used to smuggle illegal spice by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]],<ref name="DB" /> and was an aging freighter by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Because of its origins, the ship was not able to hold its own in space superiority battles.<ref name="TCW film" />

===Use under Skywalker===
====A new owner====
<div style="float:right;">[[File:Twilight_crashed.png|thumb|left|200px|The ''Twilight'' after it crashed on the surface of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].]]</div>
{{Quote|Looks like we'll have to take this bucket of bolts all the way to Tatooine!|Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="TCW film" />}}
{{Main|Battle of Teth/Legends|Mission to Jabba's Palace (Clone Wars)/Legends}}
The ''Twilight'' was on the planet [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] when Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], sought medical assistance for Hutt crime lord [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] son, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]]. It was being loaded by [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] and was being prepared for departure; nevertheless, Skywalker and Tano destroyed the battle droids and attempted to take off. At first, the freighter refused to start, but [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] managed to fire up the battered engines and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] attempted to take it to the [[Spirit of the Republic|nearest Republic cruiser]]. The sky fight above Teth prevented them from landing on the cruiser, so they were forced to take the ship directly to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. With the help of a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] and medicine, Rotta was saved from near death.<ref name="TCW film" />

Upon arriving in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatooine system]], Skywalker diverted power to the front shields instead of the rear. The ''Twilight'' was ambushed by two [[Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter/Legends|''Rogue''-class starfighters]] piloted by [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]], ironically attacking from the now-unprotected rear. Astromech droid R2-D2 unlocked the weapon systems and was able to destroy both fighters, but extensive damage to the craft caused it to crash-land into the atmosphere. After the four abandoned the ship through the rear door, [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] came by to salvage it.<ref name="TCW film" /> Skywalker later reclaimed the ''Twilight'' and modified it to update its age-induced shortcomings.<ref name="DB" /> These modifications included an increase in both top speed and agility.<ref name="Rising Malevolence Decoded">{{SWArchive|url=video/view/000807.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Decoded Episode: Rising ''Malevolence''|nobackup=1}}</ref>

====The ''Malevolence''====
[[File:Twilight_flees_from_Malevolence.png|thumb|left|200px|The ''Twilight'' flees from the damaged [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']].]]
Skywalker and Tano used the ''Twilight'' to rescue [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] after his fleet was [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|destroyed]] by a "secret" Confederacy weapon. Skywalker and Tano came upon Koon and several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], the only survivors of the battle. However, the crew was forced to shut down the ship's systems, including astromech droid R2-D2, as an enormous [[Malevolence/Legends|battleship]] approached; alerting the warship to their presence would surely mean certain doom. However, the medical droid tending to the clones was missed. After a horror of swerving through the remains of the other [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]],the group managed to get away and avoided the wave from the ship's [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] by quickly jumping to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], taking their knowledge of the deadly weapon with them.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence">{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref>

[[File:Twilight_leaving_Bormos.png|thumb|right|150px|The ''Twilight'' leaving the [[Bormus/Legends|Bormus]] [[Bormus testing facility/Legends|Testing Facility]].]]Skywalker, Tano and [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] went to the [[Bormus/Legends|Bormus]] [[Bormus testing facility/Legends|Testing Facility]] in the ''Twilight'', shortly after Skywalker was unable to acquire [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] through official means.<ref name="Procedure">''[[The Clone Wars: Procedure]]''</ref> After Shadow Squadron took the fighters back to the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], Skywalker led them through the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]] to [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|engage]] the ''Malevolence'', which [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] was planning on using to destroy an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|medical center]]. After sustaining losses, Skywalker and what remained of his squadron were able to severely damage the battleship's ion cannons, preventing the destruction of the station.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

The ''Twilight'' was later used to rescue [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] from the extensively damaged ''Malevolence'' after Grievous captured her during the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]], as the cyborg general sought to flee from the attacking Republic ''Venator'' cruisers. Skywalker and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] took the ''Twilight'' and docked at the emergency airlock below the bridge, seeing as the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were "too busy repairing the ship to notice them." After the Jedi rescued Amidala, the ''Twilight'' returned to the fleet, managing to evade Grievous in [[Soulless One/Legends|his fighter]] and several [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]]. Thanks to sabotage by Skywalker, the ''Malevolence'' was destroyed, colliding with the nearby [[Dead Moon of Antar/Legends|Dead Moon of Antar]].<ref name="Destroy Malevolence">{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}}</ref>

[[File:Between_those_tin_cans.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Twilight'' heads between two [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class frigates]].]]

====Battle of Bothawui and aftermath====
{{Main|Battle of Bothawui/Legends}}
After defeating Grievous over the planet [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], Skywalker and Tano took the ''Twilight'' to find a missing Artoo, who had disappeared after Skywalker's [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B starfighter]] was damaged. Skywalker docked the ''Twilight'' on the nearby [[Vulture's Claw/Legends|scavenger ship]] salvaging the battlefield, hoping that the ship had picked up Artoo, but was unsuccessful in locating him, who in fact had been arranged to be sold to Grievous by the ship's captain, [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]].<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />

After Skywalker headed away in his fighter to scout ahead with replacement astromech droid [[R3-S6/Legends|R3-S6]], his tracking beacon was accidentally activated, and Tano and [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] proceeded to rescue him in the ''Twilight'' from several [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class frigates]] that had arrived under command of Grievous.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />

====Mission to Skytop Station====
{{Quote|Great. There's the ''Twilight'', now where's everyone else?|Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Duel of the Droids">{{TCW|Duel of the Droids}}</ref>}}
{{Main|Mission to Skytop Station/Legends}}
[[File:Twilight_in_Skytop_Station.png|thumb|right|200px|The ''Twilight'' enters [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]].]]
After the group received a transmission from R2-D2, they tracked the droid to [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]], where Skywalker and Tano took a team of clone troopers to destroy the Confederacy [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]]. During the mission, Skywalker headed off to rescue Artoo, while Tano and the clones set explosive charges to destroy the station. However, Grievous attacked Tano and the clones, and Tano, accompanied by R3, engaged Grievous alone, while Rex and [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Denal/Legends|Denal]] planted the rest of the charges.<ref name="Duel of the Droids" />

Skywalker succeeded in rescuing Artoo, and returned to the hangar bay where he signaled the ''Twilight'' for the evacuation. The [[Unidentified clone trooper pilot (Twilight)/Legends|pilot]] brought the ''Twilight'' into the hangar and met with Skywalker and Artoo. However, after R3, Rex and Denal arrived, Skywalker learned of Tano's single combat against Grievous. Before they could rescue her, R3 revealed himself to be a spy and traitor, closing the hangar door and all entrances, and sealing the Republic forces inside the station. The droid also activated three Vulture droids, and several [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] arrived, engaging Skywalker and the clones in combat. Tano arrived, and after Artoo opened the hangar door from an outside platform (and also destroyed R3 in a duel), the Jedi and the clones fled the exploding station in the ''Twilight''.<ref name="Duel of the Droids" />

====Capturing Dooku====
{{Main|Skirmish at Vanqor/Legends|Mission to Florrum/Legends}}
[[File:TwilightOnFlorrum-DC.png|thumb|left|200px|The ''Twilight'' docked at Ohnaka's outpost]]
The ''Twilight'' was used as a ploy to get Skywalker onboard [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and Confederacy [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Count Dooku's frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class frigate]] to locate and capture the elusive Sith Lord.<ref name="Bait">''[[The Clone Wars: Bait]]''</ref> Kenobi came to assist Skywalker, and they were able to follow an escaping Dooku, but both parties crash-landed on [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]]. Dooku was captured by the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirate gang]], and was taken to [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], while Skywalker and Kenobi were rescued by Tano. When Skywalker and Kenobi were dispatched to confirm that Dooku was in the captivity of the pirates, in order for a deal to be struck between the pirates and the Republic for the transfer of Dooku's captivity, the Jedi took the ''Twilight'' to the pirates' [[Hondo's complex/Legends|stronghold]] .<ref name="Dooku Captured">{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}</ref>

Skywalker and Kenobi were captured by the pirates as well, who were additionally seeking to capture the two Jedi for ransom. The Jedi were forced to strike an uneasy alliance with Dooku, who later escaped separately. The two Jedi spared Ohnaka, showing wisdom in not arresting him in spite simply for capturing them. Skywalker and Kenobi left the planet on the ''Twilight'' with [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Stone (clone trooper)/Legends|Stone]] and a few members of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]], who had originally been sent to [[Mission to Florrum/Legends|negotiate]] the deal concerning Dooku with the pirates.<ref name="The Gungan General">{{TCW|The Gungan General}}</ref>

====Curing the Blue Shadow Virus====
{{Main|Mission to Iego/Legends}}
[[File:Drol.png|thumb|right|200px|The ''Twilight'' encounters "[[Drol/Legends|Drol]]."]]
When Tano, Senator Padmé Amidala and several clones were infected with the deadly [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]] shortly after a [[Raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory/Legends|raid]] on Confederacy-allied [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi's]] [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref> Skywalker and Kenobi took the ''Twilight'' to [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] to find an antidote known as [[Reeksa/Legends|Reeksa weed]]. There, they learned from [[Jaybo Hood/Legends|Jaybo Hood]] that "[[Drol/Legends|Drol]]," the "phantom ruler" of Iego, was preventing the inhabitants from leaving the planet. After finding the Reeksa weed and attempting to leave the planet, the Jedi discovered that "Drol" was actually an energy field, installed by the Separatists when they invaded the system. The Jedi took a few of Hood's reprogrammed Vulture droids and were able to destroy the energy field, liberating the planet and allowing the inhabitants to leave whenever they chose. Skywalker and Kenobi returned to Naboo, where they were able to give their infected friends the antidote in time.<ref name="Mystery of a Thousand Moons">{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref>

====Space battle above Devaron====
{{Main|Battle of Devaron/Legends}}
The ''Twilight'' was stationed aboard the [[Resolute/Legends|Resolute]] when the cruiser attacked [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] [[Cad Bane's Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class frigate]].<ref name="Cargo of Doom">{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}}</ref> Later, Anakin and Ahsoka took the ship to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] in order to [[Mission to Mustafar (Skywalker and Tano)/Legends|rescue]] several [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] children on the world.

====Battle at Mandalore====
{{Main|Battle of Sundari}}
{{Quote|I was wondering if I might borrow that old spice freighter of yours.''"<br />"''The ''Twilight''? Sure. Though you should know—''"<br />"''Is she spaceworthy these days?''"<br />"''The engines need tuning, and she's pitching more than I'd like, and there's a list of other little problems. If you give me and Artoo an hour—''"<br />"''As long as she'll fly, she'll land. I'm not planning on making the Kessel Run, or trying my hand at the five Fire Rings of Fornax.''"<br />"''She's all yours, then.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy" />}}
After hearing about the chaos on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy" /> Obi-Wan flew the ''Twilight'' to Mandalore to avoid detection by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]]. It already saw a significant amount of disrepair, even causing a minor blaze onboard the ship after landing before its automatic emergency systems extinguished the blaze, causing Kenobi to state that this was the last time he would borrow any ship from Skywalker. Skywalker had earlier warned him of its then-current state when Kenobi borrowed the ship, although Kenobi figured that he could use it as long as it at least could still fly and land well. The much-battered freighter now sported a cartoonish illustration of Skywalker as a boy [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] pilot, with [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] text that said "WIZARD!!!"<ref name="SW-The Lawless - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep516|text="The Lawless" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|Slide 5}}</ref>

On Mandalore, the Jedi Master freed [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] from prison and attempted to flee. Already in a state of heavy disrepair, the ''Twilight'' did not get far before being hit by three Death Watch soldiers' [[JT-12 jetpack/Legends|jetpack]]-mounted missiles. This dealt the ship irreparable damage and caused it to spin out of control, forcing Obi-Wan and Satine to exit the freighter while still in the air. The ''Twilight'' exploded seconds after their descent back to the surface of Mandalore.<ref name="TCW:Lawless">{{TCW|The Lawless}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Wizard.jpg|thumb|200px|In 20 BBY, the ''Twilight'' sported an illustration of Anakin Skywalker as a boy.]]The ''Twilight'' first appeared in ''Star Wars'' media in the [[2008]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] and its [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]], and appears multiple times in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|television series]], upon which the movie was based.<ref name="TCW film" />

''The Clone Wars'' film and television series' director, [[Dave Filoni]], describes the ''Twilight'' as being taken from some of [[Erik Tiemens]]' abandoned designs for a [[Emergency firespeeder/Legends|firefighting ship]]<ref name="TCW film Commentary">Commentary for [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref><ref name="Drawing Board">{{SW|url=news/back-from-the-drawing-board-part-2-repurposed-star-wars-technology|text=Repurposed ''Star Wars'' Technology - Back from the Drawing Board, Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> and ''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' says that it is based on unused design for the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] from [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|Episode II]]. It's final design came from [[Atsushi Takeuchi]]. A piece of lightning concept art of the ''Twilight'' being pursued by vulture droids was done by [[Matt Gaser]].<ref name="Art of TCW">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>

There is an older connection the ''Twilight'' holds that dates back all the way to [[1977]] to the original [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'']]. As a beat-up old spice freighter, the ''Twilight'' is the kernel of truth in Uncle [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars's]] lie to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] about his father: Anakin Skywalker was indeed a navigator on a spice freighter, from a certain point of view.<ref name="Beacon 240">{{HBCite|240}}</ref>

The ''Twilight''{{'s}} laser fire alternates colors multiple times. In the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], the blasts are red, as well as in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|television series]] episode "[[Downfall of a Droid]]," while in the episodes "[[Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence'']]," "[[Mystery of a Thousand Moons]]" and "[[The Lawless]]," the laser fire is blue.

[[The LEGO Group]] made a set of the ''Twilight'' called 7680 "The Twilight" released on [[July 26]], [[2008]].
